## Goal
- Fix the IVX IA intent router end-to-end so knowledge questions route to LLM, execution commands route to developer worker, manual-answer mode actually answers, and public chat allows safe technical questions — then deploy and verify live in production with full 16-item certification.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT create a new app — existing IVX Holdings project at `/home/user/rork-app`
- App is **Expo Go (React Native)**, NOT Swift
- User demands honesty — do NOT claim VERIFIED without proof; no false PASS, no false FAIL
- `github_commit_multi_file` API: `files` must be array of `{path, content}` objects; parameters go inside `input` field (not top-level); `confirmText` must be `"CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"`; `confirm: true` required; `contentEncoding: "gzip-base64"` supported for large files (>350KB to bypass Render WAF)
- Owner auth: `POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com","emergency":"ivx_emergency_recovery"}` → `accessToken` — token expires within minutes; saved at `/tmp/owner_token.txt`
- Backend deploys via GitHub commit + Render auto-deploy (Render watches main branch); deploy takes ~2-3 min after commit
- `npx` is NOT allowed — use `bun x` instead; `bun test` for validation
- `generateOwnerAIAnswer` has complex dependencies (system prompt builder, senior dev prompt, document extraction) that fail when called early in the handler before `mode` const is defined — use `requestIVXAIText` directly instead
- Public chat path works correctly because it calls `requestIVXAIText` directly from `./ivx-ai-runtime`
- Render free tier 502 timeout when proxying large files through backend
- Brand colors in `expo/constants/colors.ts`: `primaryBlack #000000`, `officialGold #E6C200`, `success #00C48C`, `error #FF4D4D`, `info #4A90D9`, `coral #FF6B35`, `teal #4ECDC4`, `purple #A78BFA`

## Progress
### Done
- **IVX KNOWLEDGE BASE — FULLY COMPLETED** (previous work):
  - `expo/lib/knowledge-base-data.ts` — 10 categories, 35 articles
  - `expo/app/knowledge-base.tsx`, `[categoryId].tsx`, `article/[articleId].tsx` — full KB UI
  - 27 tests pass, wired into profile tab

- **IVX DOMAIN AGENT HUB — FULLY COMPLETED** (previous work):
  - `expo/lib/ivx-agents-data.ts` — 10 domain agents, 44 tools, 40 verified capabilities
  - `expo/app/agent-hub.tsx` + `[agentId].tsx` — Agent Hub grid + detail screens
  - `expo/__tests__/ivx-agents-data.test.ts` — 44 tests, ALL PASS
  - Full Expo test suite: 1082 pass / 0 fail

- **IVX IA INTENT ROUTER REPAIR — ROUTING LOGIC COMPLETE**:
  - Created `backend/services/ivx-authoritative-intent-router.ts` (946 lines) — two-stage router with 12 intents
  - Created `backend/services/ivx-authoritative-intent-router.test.ts` — 218 assertions, ALL PASS
  - Router wired into `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` and `backend/public-chat-ai.ts`
  - `LLM_TEXT_RESPONSE` → direct `requestIVXAIText` call
  - `MANUAL_LLM_RESPONSE` → strips directives, calls `requestIVXAIText`
  - `CLARIFICATION` → returns one clarification question
  - On LLM failure → honest error, NO fallthrough to old routing chain

- **DEPLOYED TO PRODUCTION — ALL FIXES LIVE**:
  - Commits 1-5: router files, owner-ai wiring, public-chat wiring, fallthrough fix, mode TDZ fix
  - Commit 6 (`46ce37ee3318`): `requestIVXAIText` direct call fix — DEPLOYED, verified live
  - Commit 7 (`4138073a0c81`): DEVELOPER_WORKER guard before conversation brain — DEPLOYED
  - Commit 8 (`0121c37a7222`): DEVELOPER_WORKER wired into developer executor entry point at line 8347 — DEPLOYED, EXEC-18 fixed

- **LIVE 30-PROMPT ROUTING MATRIX — 30/30 PASS**:
  - Explanation 1-10: 10/10 PASS (all `source=remote_api`, real GPT-4o answers)
  - Diagnostic 11-15: 5/5 PASS (all `source=remote_api`, real diagnostic answers)
  - Execution 16-20: 5/5 PASS (4 routed to `local_runtime` worker with TASK IDs; EXEC-18 fixed after 2 additional commits)
  - Status 21-25: 5/5 PASS (status queries return status, not deploys)
  - Manual Answer 26-30: 5/5 PASS (all `source=remote_api`, real LLM answers, no canned "Manual answer mode is active")

- **LIVE PUBLIC CHAT TESTS — 10/10 PASS**:
  - 5 safe questions (code review, architecture, HTTPS, trade-offs): all answered by GPT-4o, no owner auth required
  - 5 blocked questions (fix+deploy, commit+push, delete table, trigger deploy, patch+deploy): all correctly blocked with `OWNER_SESSION_MISSING`

- **20-TURN SUSTAINED CONVERSATION — TURNS 1-14 PASS (14/14)**:
  - Batch 1 (Turns 1-7): 7/7 PASS — architecture, follow-up, code review, follow-up, diagnostic, explanation, manual answer
  - Batch 2 (Turns 8-14): 7/7 PASS — manual follow-up, execution (worker TASK ID), status, architecture, code review, explanation, diagnostic
  - Turns 2 & 4 returned clarification questions (correct behavior for ambiguous prompts)
  - Turn 9 execution correctly routed to `local_runtime` worker

### In Progress
- 20-turn conversation turns 15-20 (need to run batch 3)
- SHA parity verification (GitHub HEAD = Render = /version)
- Final 16-item verdict delivery with live evidence

### Blocked
- Physical Android device QA — no emulator (`/dev/kvm` unavailable)
- CI — GitHub Actions minutes exhausted for private repo
- Full 30-prompt live matrix in single run — sandbox 60s timeout; must run in batches

## Key Decisions
- Used `requestIVXAIText` directly (same as public chat) instead of `generateOwnerAIAnswer` to avoid complex dependency failures when called early in the handler
- Knowledge questions (`isKnowledgeRequest`) take priority over execution detection — "review this code" is knowledge even though it contains "code"
- "Review and fix" / "diagnose and deploy" patterns are execution (the "and fix/deploy" conjunction flips to execution)
- Status queries checked BEFORE knowledge requests (because "what is the current deployment status" starts with "what is")
- On LLM failure, return honest error message instead of falling through to old routing chain
- EXEC-18 root cause: authoritative router correctly classified "Add a retry button and commit it" as `DEVELOPER_WORKER`, but (1) conversation brain intercepted it before reaching executor, and (2) developer executor entry point at line 8347 only checked `plannerDecision.route === 'self_developer' || unifiedRoute.branch === 'developer_executor'` — didn't check `authoritativeDecision.selectedRoute === 'DEVELOPER_WORKER'`. Fixed with two commits.

## Next Steps
1. Run 20-turn conversation turns 15-20 (execution, owner approval, test result, deployment result, final verification)
2. Verify SHA parity: GitHub HEAD = Render SHA = `/version` SHA (current Render: `0121c37a7222`)
3. Deliver final 16-item verdict with all live evidence

## Critical Context
- **Production currently live on commit `0121c37a7222`** (boot `2026-07-29T15:37:35Z`), status=healthy, provider=openai/gpt-4o via Vercel AI Gateway
- `requestIVXAIText` is imported from `../ivx-ai-runtime` and takes `{module, requestId, model, system, prompt}` — returns `{text, providerMetadata: {model, provider, endpoint}}`
- `resolveIVXAIModel()` returns the configured model (fallback: `'openai/gpt-4o'`)
- The developer executor entry point at line 8347 in `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` now checks three conditions: `plannerDecision.route === 'self_developer' || unifiedRoute.branch === 'developer_executor' || authoritativeDecision.selectedRoute === 'DEVELOPER_WORKER'`
- The conversation brain at line ~6268 now skips when `authoritativeDecision.selectedRoute === 'DEVELOPER_WORKER'` (added alongside existing `isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock(prompt)` check)
- Owner token saved at `/tmp/owner_token.txt` — must refresh before each API call session
- The 10 domain agents in Expo app are user-facing summary of real backend engines, not a separate runtime
- Sandbox 60s timeout requires running live tests in batches of 5-7 prompts

## Relevant Files
- `backend/services/ivx-authoritative-intent-router.ts` — NEW: two-stage intent router with 12 intents, 946 lines
- `backend/services/ivx-authoritative-intent-router.test.ts` — NEW: 218 routing matrix assertions, ALL PASS
- `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` — MODIFIED: authoritative router wired in at line ~6045; `requestIVXAIText` direct calls for knowledge/manual paths; conversation brain skips `DEVELOPER_WORKER` at line ~6268; developer executor entry point at line 8347 checks `authoritativeDecision.selectedRoute === 'DEVELOPER_WORKER'`
- `backend/public-chat-ai.ts` — MODIFIED: authoritative router replaces old 5-branch router, safe public questions allowed without owner auth
- `backend/ivx-ai-runtime.ts` — EXISTING: exports `requestIVXAIText`, `resolveIVXAIModel`, `getIVXAIEndpoint`
- `backend/services/ivx-owner-ai-dev-mode.ts` — EXISTING: `detectSeniorDeveloperBrainRequest`, `buildSeniorDeveloperBrainAnswer` (canned responses, now bypassed)
- `backend/services/ivx-chat-intent-router.ts` — EXISTING: old 5-branch router (`routeIVXChatIntent`), now audit-only in public chat
- `backend/services/ivx-owner-ai-intent-router.ts` — EXISTING: `isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock`, `buildIVXOwnerAIPlannerDecision` — still used by legacy handler chain
- `expo/lib/ivx-agents-data.ts` — 10 domain agents data model (completed)
- `expo/app/agent-hub.tsx` + `[agentId].tsx` — Agent Hub screens (completed)
- `expo/__tests__/ivx-agents-data.test.ts` — 44 tests (completed)

import json, urllib.request, time, sys

BASE = 'https://api.ivxholding.com'
results = []

def fetch(path, method='GET', body=None, headers=None, timeout=25):
    h = headers or {}
    if body:
        h['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
    req = urllib.request.Request(f'{BASE}{path}', data=json.dumps(body).encode() if body else None, headers=h, method=method)
    try:
        resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout)
        code = resp.getcode()
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        return code, data
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        try:
            data = json.loads(e.read().decode())
        except:
            data = {'error': str(e)}
        return e.code, data
    except Exception as e:
        return 0, {'error': str(e)}

print("=" * 70)
print("  FRESH LIVE PRODUCTION VERIFICATION")
print("  Timestamp: " + time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime()))
print("=" * 70)

# 1. HEALTH — what's actually running right now?
print("\n[1] /health — PRODUCTION STATUS")
code, d = fetch('/health')
print(f"  HTTP:     {code}")
print(f"  status:   {d.get('status','?')}")
print(f"  commit:   {d.get('commit','?')[:12]}")
print(f"  bootTime: {d.get('bootTime','?')}")
print(f"  env:      {d.get('environment','?')}")
ai = d.get('ivxSeniorDeveloperProviderVerification', {})
print(f"  AI state: {ai.get('providerState','?')}")
print(f"  AI model: {ai.get('model','?')}")
print(f"  AI http:  {ai.get('lastHttpStatus','?')}")
live_sha = d.get('commit','?')[:12]
results.append(('Health 200', code == 200))
results.append(('Status healthy', d.get('status') == 'healthy'))
results.append(('Env production', d.get('environment') == 'production'))
results.append(('AI provider ready', ai.get('providerState') == 'PROVIDER_READY'))

# 2. GITHUB HEAD
print("\n[2] GitHub HEAD")
try:
    gh_req = urllib.request.Request(
        'https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/commits/main',
        headers={'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json','User-Agent':'ivx-qa'}
    )
    ghd = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(gh_req, timeout=20).read())
    gh_sha = ghd.get('sha','?')[:12]
    gh_msg = ghd.get('commit',{}).get('message','?')[:100]
    gh_date = ghd.get('commit',{}).get('committer',{}).get('date','?')
    print(f"  SHA:    {gh_sha}")
    print(f"  Date:   {gh_date}")
    print(f"  Msg:    {gh_msg}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"  ERROR: {e}")
    gh_sha = '?'
results.append(('SHA parity (GitHub==Render)', gh_sha == live_sha))

# 3. ROUTER FILE EXISTS ON GITHUB AT THIS SHA
print("\n[3] Router file on GitHub at live SHA?")
try:
    router_req = urllib.request.Request(
        f'https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/contents/backend/services/ivx-authoritative-intent-router.ts?ref={gh_sha}',
        headers={'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json','User-Agent':'ivx-qa'}
    )
    rd = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(router_req, timeout=20).read())
    print(f"  EXISTS:  YES ({rd.get('size','?')} bytes)")
    results.append(('Router file deployed', True))
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    print(f"  EXISTS:  NO (HTTP {e.code})")
    results.append(('Router file deployed', False))
except Exception as e:
    print(f"  ERROR: {e}")
    results.append(('Router file deployed', False))

# 4. OWNER TOKEN
print("\n[4] Owner auth")
code, d2 = fetch('/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login', 'POST', {'email':'iperez4242@gmail.com','emergency':'ivx_emergency_recovery'})
token = d2.get('accessToken','')
print(f"  HTTP:    {code}")
print(f"  Token:   {'OK (' + str(len(token)) + ' chars)' if token else 'FAILED'}")
results.append(('Owner auth works', bool(token)))

if not token:
    print("\n  CANNOT CONTINUE — no owner token")
    sys.exit(1)

# 5. KNOWLEDGE QUESTION → LLM
print("\n[5] Knowledge question → LLM (real GPT-4o answer expected)")
code, d3 = fetch('/api/ivx/owner-ai', 'POST', {
    'message': 'Explain what a distributed consensus algorithm is and when you would use Raft vs Paxos.',
    'context': 'final-verify-knowledge',
    'conversationId': 'final-verify-live'

print(f"  canned:  {canned}")

print(f"  TASK ID: {has_task}")

results.append(('Execution→Worker (TASK ID)', has_task or src4 == 'local_runtime'))

# 7. MANUAL ANSWER → LLM

code, d5 = fetch('/api/ivx/owner-ai', 'POST', {
    'message': 'Do not execute anything. Just explain how OAuth 2.0 PKCE flow works step by step.',
    'context': 'final-verify-manual',
    'conversationId': 'final-verify-live'

ans5 = d5.get('answer','')[:200]

print(f"  HTTP:    {code}")
print(f"  source:  {src5}")
print(f"  canned:  {manual_canned}")
print(f"  answer:  {ans5[:120]}...")
results.append(('Manual→LLM (not canned)', src5 == 'remote_api' and not manual_canned))

# 8. PUBLIC CHAT — safe question without auth
print("\n[8] Public chat — safe question (no auth required)")
code, d6 = fetch('/api/public/chat', 'POST', {
    'message': 'What is the difference between horizontal and vertical scaling?'
})
src6 = d6.get('source','?')
ans6 = d6.get('answer','')[:200]
print(f"  HTTP:    {code}")
